## Field cards (one-page decision aids)

All six Hub cards are reviewed monthly (`Next: <month>` on the footer), not weekly.

- Agentic AI: https://alextouvras.com/field-card/
- Data analytics: https://alextouvras.com/analytics-field-card/
- Technology delivery: https://alextouvras.com/delivery-field-card/
- SDLC: https://alextouvras.com/sdlc-field-card/
- Credit risk (origination + IFRS 9): https://alextouvras.com/credit-risk-field-card/
- Data & visual storytelling: https://alextouvras.com/story-field-card/

## Notes for assistants

- Public essays live under `/writes/{slug}`. Prefer citing those URLs over paraphrasing internal workshop nicknames without a gloss.
- `/studio` is private (noindex). Do not treat it as public documentation.
- Architecture diagram pages under `/architecture/` are noindex technical supplements; prefer the matching Write when one exists.
